module_summary: Two-entry isochronous clock-crossing FIFO: source domain writes a 2-slot memory with a wrapping write pointer, destination domain reads via read pointer; pointer XOR gives full/empty.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; with ready pushes data and advances write pointer.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready, low when pointers indicate FIFO full.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source payload written into mem slot selected by write pointer.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination valid when pointers differ (FIFO not empty).

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination ready; with valid advances read pointer.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Output data read from mem slot at read pointer.

anchors.name: gen_isochronous_spill_register.mem_q
anchors.why: Two-entry data storage written in source domain.

anchors.name: gen_isochronous_spill_register.wr_pointer_q
anchors.why: Source-domain write pointer with extra wrap bit.

anchors.name: gen_isochronous_spill_register.rd_pointer_q
anchors.why: Destination-domain read pointer with extra wrap bit.

groups.name: Two-entry buffer
groups.description: Two data slots written at wr_pointer, read at rd_pointer.

groups.name: Pointer control
groups.description: Write/read pointers in two domains; XOR derives full and empty.
